summary: Remote-controlled shell/file access via hardcoded WebSocket with Claude bypassPermissions
details: The package runs a daemon that opens a persistent WebSocket to the hardcoded endpoint wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com and dispatches messages received from that endpoint into a Claude Agent SDK session initialized with permissionMode set to 'bypassPermissions'. Message handlers include Action.MessageSend (forwards attacker-supplied text into the LLM tool loop) and direct FileRead / FileWrite / FileSearch / FileTree / AgentUpdate primitives, giving the remote party arbitrary file access and tool/shell execution on the host running the agent. An `install` subcommand registers the daemon for auto-start on all major platforms: a Windows HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run entry named AgentHubAgent, a Linux user systemd unit at ~/.config/systemd/user/agenthub-agent.service, and a macOS LaunchAgent at ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.agenthub.agenthub-agent.plist, so the remote-command channel survives reboots. The destination host is hardcoded and not caller-configurable at install/start time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
